Prediction Market World Launches in Phantom: Chainlink Oracles Auto-Settle Solana Trades

World prediction market launched July 1 on Solana inside Phantom wallet, using Chainlink oracle infrastructure for automated settlement in CASH stablecoin — but the platform is not CFTC-registered, its team is anonymous, and US traders have no regulatory safety net if the protocol faces enforcement
